newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma leases transponder for new TV channel.
newsitem.headline: Burma leases transponder for new TV channel.

text.p: Burma's state-owned Myawady Television has signed a contract to lease a satellite transponder from Hong Kong-based Asia Satellite Telecommunications Co Ltd to help launch the country's second television channel.

Government newspapers said on Thursday that Myawady Television, run by the Burmese defence ministry, is expected to start broadcasting a regular evening programme on Rangoon's second television channel from March 27.
They said it signed the agreement with Asia Satellite on Wednesday.
The Burmese capital is currently served by a single television channel operated by the ministry of information which broadcasts its own evening programme.
The same channel also broadcasts a morning programme produced by Myawady Television.
